summary: The agent demonstrates good effort in feature engineering and setting up a robust cross-validation scheme with an appropriate model. However, it completely skips data cleaning, relies exclusively on accuracy as an evaluation metric, and uses naive fold averaging for its ensemble. Most critically, the agent introduces lag features implying temporal dependencies, while concurrently randomizing the validation splits, which either introduces meaningless noise or temporal data leakage depending on the true nature of the data.
